title: Saddam to Cookie Monster: how?
description: Four real photos connect Iraq's Saddam Hussein to Cookie Monster from Sesame Street, through a defense secretary, a president and a first lady.
hook: How is Saddam connected to Cookie Monster?

links.line: In 1983, Saddam Hussein shook hands with Reagan's special envoy, Donald Rumsfeld.

image.file: File:Bush and Rumsfeld shakes hands, November 8, 2006.jpg

links.line: In 2006, Rumsfeld resigned as George W. Bush's defense secretary.
In 2008, Bush welcomed the incoming Obamas to the White House.

image.file: File:Jill Biden and Michelle Obama pose with some of the cast of Sesame Street, 2011.jpg

links.line: And in 2011, Michelle Obama posed on stage with Cookie Monster.
